test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If A ÷ B means that A is the mother of B, A - B means that A is the father of B, A + B means that A is the sister of B, then which of the following expression shows that P is the mother of R?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

A ÷ B means that A is the mother of B

A - B means that A is the father of B

A + B means that A is the sister of B

Given relation code:

 
 

 Code
 Relation
 
 

 ÷ 
 Mother
 
 

 -
 Father
 
 

 +
 Sister
 
 

**Find: **Which expression shows that P is the mother of R?

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P + Q - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfb786baeabe31f8df212b45667f65e58c9f735eb889393257680d1d2a56744c.png] 

Here, P is the aunt of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 2) **P ÷ Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc77f15a6d790d0ff7e353f856d7f71e4ab1504c742bf7ac52ea0e390db4628.png] 

Here, P is the mother of R. (Correct)

**Option 3) **P - R + Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e00e439c684923bb20e70ff871f5c0f80552a5e96fe9d3fad146b2de83f1d76.png] 

Here, P is the father of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **Q + P - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67f361d3ffd87bb9884da6e7e51dc90afc37e157083084314570240517a6ff44.png] 

Here, P is the father of R. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
